arguments.command:
cd /workspace/dev && cat > bench_min.py << 'PYEOF'
import importlib.util, json, random, sys, time
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('m', '/workspace/submission/main.py')
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(m)

svcs = ['t%d' % i for i in range(7)] + ['a','b','c'] + ['u%d' % i for i in range(14)]
args = [{'op':'contains','path':['t%d' % i]} for i in range(7)] + \
       [{'op':'contains','path':['a']*16}, {'op':'contains','path':['b']*16},
        {'op':'contains','path':['c']*8}]
req = {'services': svcs, 'rules': [{'action':'allow','when':{'op':'and','args':args}}],
       'queries': []}
info = m.validate(json.loads(json.dumps(req)))
sigma = info['sigma']; atoms = info['atoms']; k = len(atoms)
tables, true_states, widths = m.build_monitors(atoms, sigma, info['index'])
coltabs = [[tables[j][a] for j in range(k)] for a in range(sigma)]
t0=time.time(); states, trans = m.product_bfs(k, coltabs, sigma, m.TUPLE_CAP); t1=time.time()
print('product bfs %.3fs states=%d sigma=%d' % (t1-t0, len(states), sigma))
n = len(states)
accept = [1 if (i % 997 == 0) else 0 for i in range(n)]   # synthetic accept set

# per-round Moore cost
part = accept[:]; blocks = 2
for r in range(6):
    t0=time.time(); part, blocks, done = m.moore.__wrapped__(n, trans, part, blocks) if hasattr(m.moore,'__wrapped__') else (None,None,None)
    break
def one_round(n, trans, part):
    getter = part.__getitem__; marks={}; newp=[0]*n; c=0
    for q in range(n):
        sig = (part[q],) + tuple(map(getter, trans[q]))
        i = marks.get(sig)
        if i is None: i=c; c+=1; marks[sig]=i
        newp[q]=i
    return newp, c
part = accept[:]
for r in range(8):
    t0=time.time(); part, blocks = one_round(n, trans, part); t1=time.time()
    print('  moore round %d: %.3fs -> %d blocks' % (r, t1-t0, blocks))
    if blocks == n: break

# Hopcroft from scratch on the same automaton
part0 = accept[:]; 
t0=time.time(); p2, b2 = m.hopcroft(n, sigma, trans, part0, 2); t1=time.time()
print('hopcroft from accept partition: %.3fs -> %d blocks' % (t1-t0, b2))
# check hopcroft == moore
t0=time.time(); pm = accept[:]; bm=2
while True:
    pm, bm, done = m.moore(n, trans, pm, bm)
    if done: break
t1=time.time()
def classes(pp):
    d={}
    for q,v in enumerate(pp): d.setdefault(v,[]).append(q)
    return sorted(sorted(v) for v in d.values())
print('moore(unbounded) %.3fs -> %d blocks; equal=%s' % (t1-t0, bm, classes(pm)==classes(p2)))
PYEOF
timeout 1200 python3 bench_min.py
